items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke publicly challenged CJI Surya Kant over remarks attributed to the CJI that law-and-order matters were outside his domain, asking: 'Will you tell Modi the same thing?' The quip, made on Tuesday, adds a direct political edge to the debate over the judiciary's response to the Delhi protest crackdown and SIR dispute — days after Congress Kerala's similar 'not your domain' post drew a contempt complaint. Corroborating outlets: Hindustan Times (Arya Mishra), Kashmir Post.
items.title: 'Will you tell Modi the same thing?': Dipke publicly challenges CJI Surya Kant over 'law and order not my domain' remark
